name: MySQL Community Server

evidence.sql: C02: self-hosted relational SQL database is the primary type; D01: SQL engine with InnoDB

line: Self-hosted relational database with scheduled SQL events.

free.text: GPLv2, no hosted quota; you control uptime, disk, and retention

cells.regions: Choose the region for your own server

sql.math: $0 software license. Host, storage, backups, transfer and operations are not priced.
The software stays $0. Kept host, data, backups and operations depend on your provider.

files.math: MySQL Server does not provide separate file storage.

jobs.math: SQL events have no job fee, but they share database resources that are not priced. General worker hosting is separate.
